segments.text: Robinhood Stock Tokens trade around the clock.
But the stock price exists only six and a half hours a day.
Every trade needs a pool of tokens on the other side.
Liquidity providers fill the pool, and earn a fee on each trade.
Their danger: a trader who knows the price just moved.
We replayed five point one million real trades from the chain's own pools.
segments.cap: We replayed 5.1 million real trades from the chain's own pools.

segments.text: While the stock market is open, a provider earns about a dollar of fees per dollar lost.
segments.cap: While the stock market is open, a provider earns about $1 of fees per $1 lost.

segments.text: At night, up to three dollars. On weekends, three point eight to nineteen point five.
segments.cap: At night, up to $3. On weekends, $3.8 to $19.5.

segments.text: It varies by pool and fee tier too, and holders cannot see it.
Picking a pool by hand is guesswork.
Some pools carry hooks, small programs that can keep a hidden cut, and eighty percent of hooks are flagged malicious.
segments.cap: Some pools carry hooks, small programs that can keep a hidden cut. 80% of hooks are flagged malicious.

segments.text: Uptick does the picking.
For each Stock Token, it replays every pool and fee tier, and chooses where liquidity pays.
It only enters pools with no hidden cut, or a maximum fee declared on chain and enforced in every trade.
We sent two hundred trades over the maximum, on a copy of the real chain.
segments.cap: We sent 200 trades over the maximum, on a copy of the real chain.

segments.text: All two hundred were rejected.
For a holder, it is one deposit.
Deposit NVDA, and the vault earns the fees for you.
Uptick.
Stock Token yield, chosen by the chain's own data.
